findings.summary: Several report-level needles already pass on the base tree, so they show nothing about the new text
findings.evidence: OPEN_QUESTION_RULE (planner.rs:66) already contains "dependents" and "max_concurrency". Checking the Report for `dependents`, `max_concurrency`, `class` or `accepted` passes without the new rule. Only the `report.matches(CODE_CLAIMS_RULE).count()==1` assertion depends on the change. Fix: Check the needles against CODE_CLAIMS_RULE itself (as the REAL_RECORDS_RULE test does at briefs.rs:3956), and keep the count-once check on the Report for both inputs.

findings.summary: Wrong package for the budgets test command
findings.evidence: system_facts_budgets_match_computed is in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs (system facts), not in athena-context, so `cargo test -p athena-context system_facts_budgets_match_computed` runs zero tests. Fix: Use `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`, or rely on the full `cargo test --locked` check.

findings.summary: Criterion 2's demonstration mentions a resumed variant that no step builds
findings.evidence: Criterion 2 says the test "also builds a resumed variant". Step 3 builds only planner_inputs(None) and a PlanRevision with resumed_from: None. Fix: Add a third input with resumed_from: Some(JobId) to Step 3, or drop the claim from the demonstration.

findings.summary: Plan does not explain why more prose should work when the class recurred after an earlier prose rule
findings.evidence: HISTORY.txt:1142 (25d266c, 2026-11-03) added OPEN_QUESTION_RULE, which already asks for callers with the max_concurrency example. Introspections 20261103-163901, 20261106-002309, 20261107-045737 and 20261107-220018 record the same class after that date. 2137a1f (2026-11-08) then added a refusal in admission.rs. Fix: In the risk and the CHANGELOG, say what the new text adds that the 2026-11-03 rule lacked: citing file:line for each claim, listing producers for classifications, and settling code-named findings on revision. Also say that its effect is not measured, so a later introspection can judge it.

Both rules would name the max_concurrency path, which repeats an example the planner already reads. Fix: Use a different example, or refer to the caller list in the rule above instead of repeating the path.

summary: The plan adds one prose const, CODE_CLAIMS_RULE, to the Report section of planner_brief. It adds a test that builds a first-round brief and a revision brief, raises the bound in the Report size-pin test, and adds a CHANGELOG entry. I read planner.rs and briefs.rs. Everything the plan names exists at the lines it cites: planner_brief at planner.rs:85, the Report format string at :148, the fixtures at briefs.rs:2675/2737/2747, the existing rule test at :1818, and the size pin at :3936-3972. The size pin would fail without the planned bound change, and its name contains `planner_brief`, so the plan's filter runs it. The only caller of planner_brief outside athena-context is athena-core/src/run/planning.rs:129, which only stores and passes the text. No other test parses the Report. The dependents list is therefore complete. This matches the accepted reading: it gives the stage the information it lacked and adds no refusal rule. The new test fails on the base tree, because the const is missing and the test would not compile. I found no blocker or major findings. Minor points: the test's needles are weak (some already appear in the Report on the base tree), the test package for the budgets check is wrong, the resumed-revision case is described but has no step, and the plan does not explain why more prose should work when the class kept recurring after the similar 2026-11-03 prose rule.
